text: わざマシン「＊」で　いいんだね？

patterns.name: 〜でいい
patterns.explanation: で plus いい after a thing means that thing will do, that it is the choice you are settling on. わざマシン「＊」で　いい = 'TM "＊" is fine'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the short spoken form of のだ and, with ね, checks that the speaker has understood the situation right. いいんだね = 'so that's fine, right?'.
